name: gmail-recipient-preview
description: Local-first recipient preview for Gmail drafts.

scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown package.json package-lock.json eslint.config.mjs jsconfig.json tools tests .github docs _locales assets/store/manifest.json landing.html privacy.html README.md PRIVACY.md SECURITY_REVIEW.md TEST_CASES.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json package-lock.json eslint.config.mjs jsconfig.json tools tests .github docs _locales assets/store/manifest.json landing.html privacy.html README.md PRIVACY.md SECURITY_REVIEW.md TEST_CASES.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:security

scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm test && npm run validate:store && npm run package && npm run package:inspect
